book.name: 2 Corinth
book.title: Paul Secon Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: De Nyew Cobnant wa God Mek

Oona gwine tink dat we da staat fa taak ta oona gin bout wesef, ainty? Bot fa sho dat ain so. We ain fa do like some oda people haffa do. We ain haffa bring letta ta oona fa mek oona know ef we good, ainty? An oona ain haffa sen letta bout we ta oda people needa.
Cause oona we letta wa done been write down eenside we haat fa ebrybody fa know an read.
Oona da show fa true dat oona a letta fom Christ wa we done bring. An nobody ain tek ink fa write dis letta. God write um wid e Sperit. E ain write pon stone, bot pon people haat.
We da say dem ting yah cause we know fa true dat we kin trus God shru Christ.
We ain able fa do nottin by wesef, so we ain gwine say dat we able. God de one wa da mek we able fa do all ting wa we da do.

Same fashion, God mek we able fa be minista ob a nyew cobnant wa e mek wid people. Dat cobnant ain no law wa been write down een a book. God Sperit mek dat cobnant wid we. Cause de law wa been write down, dat condemn people ta det, bot God Sperit da gii life.

Now den, de Law wa condemn we ta det been write down pon stone. Wen God gim, e shinin glory come pon Moses. An de Israel people dem ain been able fa keep da look pon Moses face, cause e face beena shine sommuch, eben dough dat glory beena fade way.
So ef de Law wa bring det come wid sommuch glory, fa sho, de wok ob God Sperit gwine be full ob eben mo glory den dat!
De wok wa Moses done, wa condemn people, been full ob glory. Bot de wok wa God do wa mek all ting right twix God an e people, dat haffa be full ob glory heap mo den dat, fa true.
Cause dat wa been a shinin glory ain got no glory tall now wen we see de glory wa come, wa great mo den all.
De ting wa ain been fa las long, e hab glory. So den dat wa gwine las faeba, dat eben mo full op wid glory.
Now den, cause we know we kin look fowaad ta dat, we ain fraid tall fa taak plain fa God.
We ain like Moses wa been kiba e face so dat de Israel people ain see dat de shinin glory beena fade an gone way.

Bot fa true, jes like dat ting wa kiba Moses face, sompin been mek dem Israel people so dat dey ain git ondastandin bout dat. Eben op ta taday, dat same ting dey wa da mek um so dat dey ain ondastan wen dey da read de book dem wa taak bout de ole cobnant. Cause jes wen somebody come fa be one wid Christ, jes den dat face kiba gone an e git dat ondastandin.
Eben op ta taday, wensoneba dey da read de Law wa God gii Moses, dey ain ondastan.
Bot wen somebody ton ta de Lawd, God mek um git ondastandin bout dat.
Now den, de Lawd, e de Sperit. Wehsoneba de Sperit ob de Lawd dey, de people free.
So now dat God done moob de kiba fom we face, wensoneba people see we, dey see de glory ob de Lawd da shine fom we. An God Sperit da mek we jes like de Lawd wid mo an mo ob e glory.
